description: The official Mass Mobilization codebook/manual and its version, universe, and variable rules were not reviewed in this unit. Event coding therefore follows the documented extension protocol only; the official baseline gate remains pending.
required_followup: Coordinator obtains and records the official codebook/version and applies its inclusion, date, location, participant, demand, and response rules before consolidation.

description: The 5 January Praia march is documented by one opened ASEMANA report (S001). It describes “thousands” qualitatively, with no exact lower or upper bound. Targeted searches did not find independent same-event corroboration in this pass; search-result copies or later republications would not constitute independent confirmation.
required_followup: Locate an independent contemporaneous report, organizer record, or other primary documentation; preserve the qualitative wording unless an explicit numeric estimate is found.

description: S001 follows the march to the National Assembly until about 18:00 and describes security around the Government Palace and blocked Assembly entry, but does not establish a dispersal or other listed coercive response. Exact event closure and whether the access blockade meets the original response rule remain unresolved. A search for related August 2022 slogans did not establish continuous physical action into January.
required_followup: Review independent event reporting or organizer records for closure and any subsequent action; apply the official crowd-dispersal rule without inferring it from security presence or blocked entry.

description: A Nação search results (S002, S004) describe a Praia municipal-guard strike and a planned concentration, but both exact-URL article-body attempts returned native-tool cache misses before HTTP. These are technical retrieval failures, not publisher denials. The snippets do not verify strike execution, a public assembly, 50 attendees, or a complete account of the demands and municipal response.
required_followup: If pursued in a later pass, use a fresh exact-URL access receipt before each retry; seek an accessible contemporaneous report or direct union/municipal record and verify any public gathering and attendance independently of workforce size.

description: The planned Praia municipal-employees demonstration report (S005) also returned a native-tool cache miss before HTTP. The captured result/title says it was suspended after an understanding, but the article body, negotiation outcome, and any rescheduled event were not verified. No denial was observed.
required_followup: Check later contemporaneous reporting or an organizer/municipal record for the outcome and any rescheduled public assembly; do not infer either occurrence or absence from the suspension notice alone.

description: The Marxa Cabral evidence (S003, S006) is pre-event. S003 anticipates “dozens,” not a number, and S006 describes a four-day program culminating in a planned 20 January march and simultaneous Sal activity. Neither confirms post-event execution or 50 attendees. The mix of cultural commemoration and political critique leaves the specific domestic state target open; the common event unit for Praia and Sal is unresolved.
required_followup: Find post-20 January coverage or organizer documentation confirming occurrence and actual attendance; verify specific state-directed demands, the Praia/Sal coordination, Sal venue, and whether any part of the four-day program was itself a qualifying public action.

description: Searches surfaced two similarly named Marxa Kabral exhibition-catalog PDFs (S007, S008). The first body attempt returned a tool error; the second exceeded the native-tool content limit and a page screenshot returned no rendered pixels or readable text. The files may be mirrors, but origin identity was not verified; no attendance or image count was inspected.
required_followup: If these catalogs are reviewed later, verify file identity/origin and inspect the relevant pages through an authorized accessible method, with a fresh exact-URL receipt before each attempt; do not treat a mirror as independent reporting.

description: The Mindel Insite result (S009) reports only a private-company strike notice concerning SEFI workers and supplies no public assembly or count. The apparent target is the employer rather than domestic state policy; the result is search-only.
required_followup: Revisit only if later evidence indicates a public assembly with a domestic state-policy demand; otherwise retain the documented private-target exclusion.

description: This bounded open-web pass used nine captured grouped queries and 182 returned result headers, covering general and weekly date searches, Portuguese and some Cape Verdean Creole wording, local/national outlets, candidate follow-up, and island/sector leads. It did not reproduce LexisNexis or a systematic national/regional press-archive search; indexing and source coverage are uneven, and many results were geographic or topic noise.
required_followup: A later coverage pass should use available press archives and relevant official/rights-organization records, document the search frame and inaccessible holdings, and keep all findings separate from claims of event absence.

description: Searches included Portuguese and selected Kriolu/Kriolu-spelling terms, but this was not a systematic review of Cape Verdean Creole variants or island-level media archives. Praia coverage is more visible in the captured results than coverage for other islands.
required_followup: Expand later searches with locally used Creole spellings and regional outlet archives, especially for Mindelo, Sal, and other islands; retain language and geographic coverage limits in any summary.
